The company offers two main products: AI Tools, which facilitate seamless integration into workflows for automating repetitive tasks, and AI Agents, which streamline complete workflows in areas such as marketing, sales, and research. Relevance AI aims to empower teams, ensuring limitations are driven by ideas, not size.

product.name: AI Workforce Platform
product.description: A platform to build, customize, and manage teams of autonomous AI agents that perform business tasks without coding.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: Autonomous AI agents that execute tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems based on AI capabilities, customizable without coding.

product.name: AI Tools
product.description: Customizable AI-powered tools that provide AI agents with specific capabilities like API calls, data processing, and automation.

product.name: AI App Builder
product.description: A no-code platform to create, deploy, and share custom AI applications quickly, with embeddable widgets and API access.

product.name: Custom Actions for GPTs
product.description: A platform to build and deploy custom GPT actions with no-code and code options, usable as AI tools or white-labeled agents.

product.name: Customer Support AI Agent
product.description: An AI agent designed to automate customer support by handling inquiries, routing tickets, and generating context-aware responses.
